finding.evidence: These supporting records say Brandt–Horn explicitly leaves DDP-rate optimality open. In conclusion §4, printed p. 17, the explicit optimality question follows the a-priori-rate discussion; the next sentence separately states the finite-qualification DDP rate without explicitly posing its sharpness. The assigned item's Status accurately distinguishes these claims. See [Brandt and Horn, §4, p. 17](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13483), extracted PDF lines 2880–2895.
